provenance.label: The 10 MPa default line pressure is a demonstration fixture representing a firm brake application. It is not taken from a vehicle brake-system specification.

The clamping load is modelled as hydraulic pressure on the piston bore pocket plus an equal and opposite resultant force spread over the outboard pad abutment face. The piston, pads and disc are not modelled, and pad pressure distribution is assumed uniform.
The two mounting hole barrels are fully fixed. Bolt pretension, friction and contact separation at the knuckle are not modelled, so stress around the mounting holes is indicative only.
Only the clamping (mouth-opening) load case is analysed. The brake torque reaction that acts circumferentially through the mounting bolts is a separate load case and is not included here.

The 165 MPa default allowable stress is a demonstration value derived as roughly the 250 MPa catalog yield of EN-GJS-400-18 divided by a safety factor of 1.5. The 0.15 mm default mouth opening limit is likewise illustrative. Both are stated so the constraint is active across the design space; replace them with limits from your own design standard and certified material data.

Simplified fixed-caliper body template: U-shaped channel over the disc, piston bore pocket in the inboard leg, mounting holes through the inboard leg, optional bridge ribs. The hydraulic circuit, seal grooves, pistons, pads, disc, and casting draft are not modelled. Disc slot width, piston bore diameter, mounting hole pattern and body length are preserved interfaces and cannot be changed by the optimizer.
